verdict.rationale: Bolna has a dedicated call-pricing docs page and states that bring-your-own-key components and connected providers are not charged. BYOT lets users apply their own calling rates, which implies a component-based usage model. However, the evidence shows no actual per-minute rates, so a founder cannot estimate cost per call from this pack. Missing for 10: published per-minute or usage rate figures, a per-call cost breakdown or calculator, plan tiers, and independent confirmation of pricing transparency.
